heading: Thursday Night
text: Clear to partly cloudy. Lows from the mid 30s to lower 40s, except low to mid 30s in northern cold hollows, and mid to upper 40s in the Champlain Valley. Winds diminishing to light and variable, remaining north 5 to 10 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Friday
text: Patchy fog early. Otherwise mostly sunny in the morning. Remaining mostly sunny in the afternoon from the Champlain Valley north and west. Increasing high clouds elsewhere. Highs in the upper 60s to lower 70s, some mid 70s possible in the warmer valleys north. North to northeast winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 20 mph far south and in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Friday Night
text: Partly cloudy from the Champlain Valley north and west. Mostly cloudy elsewhere, with a chance of showers from the southern Greens eastward. Lows from the mid 40s to lower 50s, some lower 40s in the Adirondacks. North to northeast winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 20 mph far south and in the Champlain Valley.
